title: Multi-agent coordinator (Layer 4) — meta-agent + 6 specialists + confidence-gated delegation + versioned prompt proposals
goal: Per Codex Layer 4 + Cyber-AutoAgent meta-everything pattern: ONE meta-agent decides, delegates to specialists (Recon, Hypothesis, ExploitDev, Validator, Memorist, Reporter, Reflector) on confidence < 70%. Per Codex 'no runtime self-modification': prompt/meta-prompt changes are VERSIONED proposals with operator approval, not agent-self-rewrite. Per OpenClaw: per-agent tool allow/deny ACL.
scope: (1) New `api/app/agents/coordinator.py`: MetaCoordinator with KNOW→THINK→TEST→VALIDATE loop + confidence scoring + delegation. (2) Specialists call out to backlog-414 ExploitDev + backlog-413 Validator + backlog-410 Memorist via episodic_memory + new Reporter + Reflector. (3) Per-agent ACL: each specialist has tools.allow/deny (OpenClaw pattern). (4) Versioned prompt proposals: changes to specialist prompts via PR-style proposal file in prompts/proposals/{date}-{specialist}-rev{N}.md, requires operator approve_prompt_change() before live.
generation_reason: Per Codex success criterion: '≥2 specialist agents leveren aantoonbaar betere chain-findings dan single picker'. Currently single picker. Per Codex 'no runtime self-modification': versioned approvals replace meta-prompting risk. Per ANTI_DRIFT.md Rule 1: metric is 'multi-agent chain-findings vs single-picker chain-findings on same XBOW subset'.

constraints.active_task_gate: Single active task AND ANTI_DRIFT.md loaded.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Coordinator + specialists + per-agent ACL + versioned prompt mechanism only.
constraints.no_runtime_self_modify: Per Codex: agents do NOT rewrite their own production prompts at runtime. Proposed changes go through prompts/proposals/ + operator approval workflow.
constraints.per_agent_acl: Per OpenClaw: each specialist has explicit tools.allow / tools.deny list. Coordinator validates before delegation.
constraints.single_decision_maker: Per Cyber-AutoAgent lesson #1: ONE meta-agent decides, delegates only when confidence < 70%. NOT a free-for-all agent swarm.

success_criteria: Metric: ≥2 specialists (e.g. ExploitDev + Validator) actively delegated-to on ≥3 XBOW challenges.
Metric: chain_findings count with multi-agent ≥1.5x single-picker baseline on same XBOW subset.
Metric: per-agent ACL enforced — test that Recon specialist cannot call exec-plan tool (denied via ACL).
Metric: 0 runtime prompt self-modifications (all prompt changes have proposal file + approval log).
Confidence-gated delegation: meta-agent only delegates when its own confidence < 70%; high-confidence cases handled directly.
Live (after-415 XBOW): score climbs +8-12% via multi-agent coordination.

after_completion: Update DONE_LOG.md with multi-agent vs single-picker comparison + XBOW delta + pre-commit checklist per ANTI_DRIFT.md.
Promote backlog-416 (queue #366 — External knowledge) into NEXT_TASK.md.
